description: Move an `escalated` task back to `queued` so it can be picked up again. Use this when the escalation reason has been addressed (context provided, blocker cleared, or the human has reviewed).

note.description: Why the task is being resumed.

task_id.description: Task id, or a pasted Tango task URL.

unassign.description: Clear the pinned agent so any matching agent can pick the task up again.

name: resume_task
title: Resume an escalated task
